subject: agi-safety-5frameworks-gap

metrics.common_flaw: The AI builder also assesses its own safety. No independent, neutral, measurement plane with signed audit artifacts that multiple frameworks can consume.

anthropic_rsp.name: Anthropic Responsible Scaling Policy
anthropic_rsp.mechanism: AI Safety Levels (ASL-1 through ASL-4) with capability thresholds
anthropic_rsp.flaw: Self-assessed by Anthropic. No independent third-party measurement plane.
anthropic_rsp.csoai_gap_filled: Independent measurement of ASL levels — signed cards showing whether thresholds truly met

google_deepmind_fsf.name: Google DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework
google_deepmind_fsf.mechanism: Critical Capability Levels for autonomous replication, cyber-offense, bioweapon risk
google_deepmind_fsf.flaw: No public audit protocol. Internal-only assessment.
google_deepmind_fsf.csoai_gap_filled: Public, verifiable measurement of CCLs — anyone can check Google's claims

openai_preparedness.name: OpenAI Preparedness Framework
openai_preparedness.mechanism: Risk scores: cyber, CBRN, persuasion, model autonomy. Low/Med/High/Critical.
openai_preparedness.flaw: Preparedness team reports to CEO. Not structurally independent. Score methodology partially proprietary.
openai_preparedness.csoai_gap_filled: Independent reproduction of OpenAI's risk scores with public methodology

uk_aisi.name: UK AI Safety Institute
uk_aisi.mechanism: Government-backed pre-deployment testing of frontier models
uk_aisi.flaw: Limited to frontier model evaluations (not continuous monitoring). No open measurement standard. Government-funded, not neutral-private.
uk_aisi.csoai_gap_filled: Private-sector neutral complement — continuous monitoring + open standard + non-government

nist_ai_rmf.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
nist_ai_rmf.mechanism: 4 functions: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage. Voluntary. Cross-sector taxonomy.
nist_ai_rmf.flaw: Framework/taxonomy only. No automated measurement, no signed outputs, no threshold enforcement.
nist_ai_rmf.csoai_gap_filled: Maps CSOAI's 22 axes onto NIST's Govern-Map-Measure-Manage — automatic, signed, verifiable

metrics.market_gap: CSOAI fills the gap: independent, neutral, signed measurement plane that all 5 frameworks can consume
metrics.competitive_moat: 1500+ HuggingFace repos measured, 22 axes, signed cards, Bitcoin-anchored merkle root, GSPC board at councilof.ai. No one else has this.
metrics.positioning: CSOAI is NOT competing with Anthropic/DeepMind/OpenAI — CSOAI is the INDEPENDENT MEASUREMENT LAYER they all need but none will build (because it must be neutral)

honest_sentence: All 5 AGI safety frameworks (Anthropic RSP, DeepMind FSF, OpenAI Preparedness, UK AISI, NIST AI RMF) share the same flaw: AI builder assesses own safety. CSOAI's independent measurement plane fills this gap — the scale-ai-of-AI-safety (but neutral, never conflicted).
